prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Brazilian woman — the personification of Rio de Janeiro — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Rio de Janeiro as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Place: the open cockpit of a brass biplane resting on a grass airfield, the control stick in front of her and dials gleaming
Season: winter — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; lamps lit inside, the window dark with night.
Outfit: a jungle-explorer look — a khaki shirt knotted under the bust with rolled sleeves, cargo shorts, a canvas utility belt and lace-up boots — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a silk ribbon tied in her hair; right now — mid-task she has pushed her sleeves up above the elbows and opened one more button at the collar, baring her forearms and collarbones, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window; she is seen through window glass with faint reflections on it.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands rest on the wheel in front of her.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a small polished brass climbing hammer with a looped silk wrist cord — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
acceptance: User selected world option 4 and authorized this set and main update without further confirmation.

observations: Side view and both hands on steering wheel follow plan; numerals visible on gauges, recorded without blocking.
